label: early-to-mid original-phase steps (t=3-5) after an n at positions 1-3
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, plus weakly at the <DEL> step (2.7% of mass), and never in the copy phase. It is concentrated at t=3-5 (96% of mass) and never fires at t=0-1. Magnitude depends heavily on the letter n appearing early in the sequence: prev2_tok=n has 10x lift and prev_tok=n has 7x. The strongest activations (max 4.4) come at t=3-4 in sequences beginning n n n or x n n n, where the step right after the n-run peaks. Predicate: t in 3-5 and an n already seen at original position 1, 2 or 3 (dev P=0.84, R=0.54, mass recall 0.81). Missed activations are weak (bottom two quartiles), at t=3-6 in sequences with no early n, so a low-level positional component fires at t~4 regardless of n. Inputs that are themselves first occurrences have higher rates (in_first lift 1.7x). It does not depend on digits, sequence length, or which token comes next.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig2=n (+7.39), prev2_tok=n (+5.55), orig1=n (+5.52), prev3_tok=n (+4.22), t=4 & prev_tok=n (+2.80), orig2=s (+2.23). Lower it: phase=2 (-13.94), t=8 (-8.96), prev2_tok=- (-8.60), t=7 (-8.35).
